name: V.S. Industry Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公告任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，亦无新合约公布；公告主要为股东大会文件、ESOS新股发行、未决诉讼更新及董事委员会人事变动。最新季度营收同比上升16.3%，但全年营收较上年下降，净利润由盈转亏。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business segment expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal, nor any new contracts; announcements mainly comprised general meeting documents, ESOS new share issuances, updates on pending litigation, and changes in board committee memberships. Latest quarterly revenue rose 16.3% year-on-year, but full-year revenue declined from the prior year and net profit turned from profit to loss.
